title.en: Not going out of a region

statement.en: Nothing in a region goes out of it along a relation exactly where what is not outside is closed under it; a closed region is not gone out of, and the two are one where membership is stable. Where each step keeps to the region or leaves it, a line from inside to outside has a step out, placed on it.
statement.zh: 一域沿一关系不出，恰是不外于域者在此关系下闭；闭之域不出，凡不外者皆内处二者为一。每步或守于域或出之，则自内至外之线上有一出步，定其所在。

laws.en: Nothing in a region goes out of it along a relation where no member bears the relation to something outside. A closed region is not gone out of, an occurrence's closure among them, the closure law read through not going out; not going out is exactly the closedness of what is not outside the region, with no decision; and where membership is stable, whatever is not outside lying inside, not going out is being closed.
laws.zh: 一域沿一关系不出，谓无一员以此关系及于域外者。闭之域不出，一发生之所闭亦然，即闭包之律经不出读之；不出恰是不外于域者之闭，不用判定；凡不外者皆内处，不出即闭。
declarations: Becoming.«不出当且仅当不外者闭»
Becoming.«不外者内则不出当且仅当闭»

laws.en: Nothing comes into a region along a relation, nothing outside bearing it to a member, exactly where nothing goes out of what lies outside the region, with no decision. Along a symmetric relation nothing goes out of a region exactly where nothing comes in; some relation that is not symmetric has a closed region something outside comes into.
laws.zh: 无物沿一关系入一域（无域外者以之及于员），恰是域外者不出，不用判定。关系对称时，不出恰是不入；且有不对称之关系，沿之闭域有域外者入之。
declarations: Becoming.«逆之不出当且仅当外者不出»
Becoming.«对称则不出当且仅当逆不出»

laws.en: A line of continuation under any class from a member of a region to something outside it makes it false that nothing in the region goes out of it, with no decision; it names no step going out.
laws.zh: 任一类下自域之一员至域外者之续线，则此域非不出，不用判定；未指何步出之。

laws.en: Where every step of continuation keeps to the region, its end a member wherever its start is, or goes from a member to something outside, a line from a member to something outside has a step going out, reached from the start and reaching the end: the mark law, with keeping to the region as what the ends fail. Where membership is decided every step is of one kind or the other.
laws.zh: 每步续或守于域（始为员则终亦为员）或自员出至域外，则自员至域外之线上有一出步，自始可及，可及其终：即两端分则中有标之律，以守于域为两端所不合者。属与否已判定处，每步皆为二者之一。
declarations: Becoming.«定则内至外之线有出步»

hypotheses.en: No axiom: every cited declaration has an empty axiom report, in core modules held to the core's conditions (Lean's prelude only).
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理：所引每项声明的公理报告皆空，所在模块属核心，守核心之条件（仅用 Lean 前奏）。

hypotheses.en: Any carrier, any relation and any region given by a Prop-valued predicate; a line is a finite chain of steps of continuation (相续) under any class, the relation met with the class.
hypotheses.zh: 任意载体、任意关系，及以取 Prop 值之谓词给出之任意域；线是任一类下有限步之续（相续），续即关系与类之合。

hypotheses.en: «不外者内则不出当且仅当闭» takes as a hypothesis that membership is stable, whatever is not outside the region lying in it; «内至外之线有出步» that every step of continuation keeps to the region, its end a member wherever its start is, or goes from a member to something outside; «定则内至外之线有出步» that membership is decided; «对称则不出当且仅当逆不出» that the relation is symmetric.
hypotheses.zh: «不外者内则不出当且仅当闭» 以凡不外者皆内为假设；«内至外之线有出步» 以每步续或守于域（始为员则终亦为员）或自员出至域外为假设；«定则内至外之线有出步» 以属与否已判定为假设；«对称则不出当且仅当逆不出» 以关系对称为假设。

does_not_show.en: That a region nothing goes out of is closed: where membership is not stable, what a member bears the relation to is only not outside. Its holding for every carrier in Type, relation and region is excluded middle, a lemma of «不外者内则不出当且仅当闭».
does_not_show.zh: 不出之域闭：非凡不外者皆内时，员所及者只是不外于域；于 Type 之每一载体、关系与域皆闭恰为排中，是 «不外者内则不出当且仅当闭» 之引理。
does_not_show.witness: Becoming.«不出皆闭当且仅当排中»

does_not_show.en: That a closed region is not come into: along some relation that is not symmetric, something outside bears it to a member of a closed region.
does_not_show.zh: 闭之域无物可入：有不对称之关系，沿之有域外者及于闭域之员。

does_not_show.en: Where on a line a step going out lies, or that one exists, when the steps are not split into keeping and going out: then only that the region is not one nothing goes out of.
does_not_show.zh: 步不分守与出时，线上之出步在何处，或有无：此时只得此域非不出。

does_not_show.en: A graded boundary, or which relation a self's boundary is drawn along: the laws hold for any region and relation and choose neither.
does_not_show.zh: 有等级之边界，或自身之边界沿何关系划：诸律于任意域与关系成立，二者皆不择。

detail.en: The witness of «不出皆闭当且仅当排中»: two occurrences, the relation from the first to the second, and the region of the first or a proposition S. Where ¬¬S is given nothing goes out of the region, and its being closed gives S.
detail.zh: «不出皆闭当且仅当排中» 之见证：二发生，自前者至后者之关系，与「为前者或命题 S 成立」之域。已给 ¬¬S 时此域不出，而其闭即得 S。

detail.en: A closed region come into («闭而有入之例»): the same relation, the region of the second occurrence; it is closed, the first, outside it, bears the relation to the second, and the second does not bear it to the first, so the relation is not symmetric.
detail.zh: 可入之闭域（«闭而有入之例»）：同一关系，后一发生之域；此域闭，在外之前者以此关系及于后者，而后者不及于前者，故此关系不对称。

next_delta.en: State a graded boundary on the grammar: nested regions along one relation, the steps by which one line goes out of each, and how they lie along it.
next_delta.zh: 在文法上陈述有等级之边界：沿一关系之相套诸域，一线出每一域之步，及其在线上之次第。

correspondence.en: In graph terms a region nothing goes out of has no edge leaving it, and a closed region holds every successor of its members. Classically the two are one; constructively the first is the closedness of the region's double negation, they coincide on stable regions, and that they coincide on all is excluded middle. A line from inside to outside crossing a leaving edge is a discrete intermediate value property, the mark law read on a region. Where membership is not stable, not going out leaves open where what a member bears the relation to lies: the logic's gap between a proposition and its double negation, not a fact of relations (the AI's reading).
correspondence.zh: 以图论言，不出之域无出边，闭之域含其员之每一后继。经典逻辑中二者为一；构造地，前者即域之双重否定之闭，二者于稳定之域上合一，于一切域上合一恰为排中。自内至外之线越一出边，是离散之介值性质，即两端分则中有标之律读于一域。非凡不外者皆内处，不出未定员所及者在何处：此是命题与其双重否定之间的逻辑缺口，非关系之事实（AI 的读法）。

detail.en: «闭», «所闭», «闭之及» and «所闭之界» from the closure law, «所闭不出» being «所闭之界» read through «不出».
detail.zh: «闭»、«所闭»、«闭之及» 与 «所闭之界» 出自闭包之律；«所闭不出» 即经 «不出» 所读之 «所闭之界»。

detail.en: «续», «相续», «及», «逆», «则», «相续含于及» and the mark law «两端分则中有标».
detail.zh: «续»、«相续»、«及»、«逆»、«则»、«相续含于及» 与两端分则中有标之律 «两端分则中有标»。

detail.en: Its cut is not going out at a valuation's relation, by definition, with closed regions cuts, stable cuts closed and conveyance's relation symmetric (its seventh law); its sixth law reads the crossing on a self's boundaries.
detail.zh: 其切口依定义即一赋值之关系下之不出，闭域是切口，凡不外者皆内之切口闭，输送之关系对称（其第七律）；其第六律把穿越读于自身之边界。

detail.en: Its «所经必同» is proved from «定则内至外之线有出步»: a step going out of the region lands in the set.
detail.zh: 其 «所经必同» 由 «定则内至外之线有出步» 证得：出域之一步落于该集。

detail.en: The closures under a relation are the least boundaries along it, each not gone out of.
detail.zh: 一关系下之诸所闭是沿之之最小边界，皆不出。

detail.en: A like gap of double negation: refuting every separation refutes only being unreached, as not going out gives only what is not outside.
detail.zh: 双重否定之同类缺口：否证每种分开只否证不可及，犹不出只得不外于域者。

history.en: 31 October 2026, board item BD2: created. The formal gap BD's reading of boundaries left (the World's cut defined apart from the grammar's closed region) closed by the grammar's not going out (Becoming.GrammarCrossing): its laws against the closed region, going out and coming in, and the step going out on a line, with the excluded-middle lemma as a witness of what it does not show; the World's cut read as it by definition in conveyance-crosses-the-boundary's seventh law; «所经必同» proved from the step going out. Home 01 §9.9.
history.zh: 2026年10月31日，工作板条目 BD2：创建。BD 之边界读法所留之形式缺口（世界的切口与文法之闭域分别定义）以文法之不出（Becoming.GrammarCrossing）补之：其对闭域之诸律、出与入，及线上之出步，以排中之引理为其所不示者之见证；世界的切口依定义读作不出，见 conveyance-crosses-the-boundary 第七律；«所经必同» 由出步证得。归于 01 §9.9。
